pages.heading: Harbor Line Ferry: Schedule
sentences: Harbor Line Ferry runs between Pier 4 and Gull Island.
The last weekday departure from Pier 4 is 10:40 p.m.
Saturday and Sunday last departures leave at 9:15 p.m.
Boarding closes ten minutes before departure.
The crossing takes thirty five minutes in clear weather.

pages.heading: Harbor Line Ferry: Fares
sentences: Adult fare is 14 dollars each way.
The senior fare is 7 dollars with photo identification.
A bicycle pays a 3 dollar rack fee and must sit on the stern rack.
Tickets are sold at the Pier 4 window until boarding closes.

pages.heading: Harbor Line Ferry: Safety
sentences: Life jackets are stored in the port locker beside the wheelhouse.
In a medical emergency, call the duty officer on channel 16 and then the harbor clinic at 555-0148.
Fog delays hold the boat at the dock until visibility exceeds one mile.
Do not board during a posted fog hold.

pages.heading: Harbor Line Ferry: Freight
sentences: The deck crane limit is 800 pounds.
Live animals travel only in approved crates on the freight well.
Propane and loose fuel are refused.
Freight closes twenty minutes before departure.
